cases.name: original_builtin
cases.input_xml:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<sdf version="1.6">
  <model name="m1">
    <link name="link1">
      <sensor name="camera1" type="camera">
        <update_rate>10</update_rate>
        <frame_id>base_camera</frame_id>
        <topic>/test/integration/CameraPlugin_imagesWithBuiltinSDF</topic>
        <camera>
          <horizontal_fov>1.05</horizontal_fov>
          <image>
            <width>256</width>
            <height>257</height>
          </image>
          <clip>
            <near>0.1</near>
            <far>10.0</far>
          </clip>
          <noise>
            <type>gaussian</type>
            <mean>0.0</mean>
            <stddev>0.007</stddev>
          </noise>
          <lens>
            <type>custom</type>
            <scale_to_hfov>false</scale_to_hfov>
            <custom_function>
              <c1>1.1</c1>
              <c2>2.2</c2>
              <c3>3.3</c3>
              <f>1.2</f>
              <fun>sin</fun>
            </custom_function>
            <cutoff_angle>0.7505</cutoff_angle>
            <env_texture_size>128</env_texture_size>
            <intrinsics>
              <fx>280</fx>
              <fy>281</fy>
              <cx>162</cx>
              <cy>124</cy>
              <s>1.2</s>
            </intrinsics>
            <projection>
              <p_fx>282</p_fx>
              <p_fy>283</p_fy>
              <p_cx>163</p_cx>
              <p_cy>125</p_cy>
              <tx>1</tx>
              <ty>2</ty>
            </projection>
          </lens>
        </camera>
      </sensor>
    </link>
  </model>
</sdf>
